materialPrerequisites: Coverage of the hardest exchange; declare fiction
pictureRhythm: Record eyelines, direction and prop state
Intentional axis changes need orientation clues
audio: Dialogue, object sound and music have separate roles
captions: Use deterministic layers for exact clocks, dates and text
failureModes: Expensive unused shot retained for sunk cost
acceptance: New viewers can explain goal and change
Action and sound across cuts have a reason
Watch the hardest exchange with sound
fallback: Reduce scene/characters if coverage is missing
Try reordering or local composition before regeneration
capabilityBoundaries: CutVoke executes discovered commands, editable captions, existing effects, audio mixing and preview/export; query current help for each payload.
Selection, narrative, facts, rights, meaningful timing and perceptual review remain external Agent/human decisions.
Do not assume automated semantic footage search, speaker identification, UI recognition or factual verification; unsupported work becomes an explicit gap, not an invented command.

workflow.prerequisite: Verify brief, usable source ranges and gaps; purpose/style/delivery are separate.
workflow.output: Project-local plan JSON with current project/revision/sequence, evidence roles, protected ranges and shot intentions.

workflow.prerequisite: Discover exact commands; acquire lease; rational times, stable commandId and current revision.
workflow.output: Editable rough cut; use edit.batch for one undo point. Release lease in finally.

workflow.prerequisite: Bind every artifact to rendered revision. preview_frames max 6; preview_prepare is full-length. For a bounded dynamic prototype use export.enqueue range, never invent a preview range argument.
workflow.output: Actual frames and continuous AV. Low-resource: inspect one representative range at a time and bounded polling; never lower final quality without consent.

workflow.prerequisite: Inspect actual output where sensory input is supported; record pending evidence otherwise.
workflow.output: Timecoded issues, evidence IDs, inspector, suggested local action and semantic preserve requirements. No automatic artistic score.

workflow.prerequisite: Supply repair document plus plan/review for the same current revision and active sequence.
workflow.output: Read-only existing edit.batch preview, scope/protection checks and exact nextCall when valid. Nothing is committed. Semantic preserve statements still require source/perceptual review.

workflow.prerequisite: Acquire lease and submit the previewed payload with same expectedRevision and stable commandId. On conflict reconcile and preview again.
workflow.output: New revision invalidates prior evidence. Rebuild artifacts, inspect affected neighbors and full AV, then export and review final bytes.
